games.name: SCI - Pathos III
games.desc:
Special Containment Procedures Foundation
SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
─────────────────────────────────
Welcome to SCI - Pathos III, one of the most well-known SCP Foundations within the Roblox SCP Genre.
Pathos III is the designation of an installation of facilities created by the SCP Foundation located deep within the Pacific Ocean. The exact depth of the facility remains classified. 

By creating cutting-edge technology and pioneering new containment procedures for the Foundation abroad, this installation contains some of the most dangerous anomalies. It is considered one of the most well-kept strongholds in human history and provides the Foundation with a unique testbed for interactions with anomalous entities and artifacts.
─────────────────────────────────
! 𝐀𝐓𝐓𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 !
The player begins the game as a Class D used in anomalous experiments by the SCP Foundation. In order to join the Foundation, you must apply for Security Class 0.
